keywords.meaning_vi: create-trail qua CLI mặc định tạo single-Region trail — nguyên nhân của sự cố.

references.title: Using the update-trail command to update a trail
references.section: Converting a single-Region trail to a multi-Region trail
references.quote: To change an existing single-Region trail to a multi-Region trail, use the --is-multi-region-trail option.
references.supports: Có thể sửa trực tiếp trail hiện có thành multi-Region (lựa chọn D).

references.title: Understanding multi-Region trails and opt-in Regions
references.section: What happens when you create a multi-Region trail?
references.quote: CloudTrail delivers log files for account activity from all enabled AWS Regions to the single Amazon S3 bucket that you specify
references.supports: Trail chỉ có hai phạm vi (một Region hoặc tất cả Region đã bật); multi-Region trail gửi log mọi Region về một bucket.

references.title: Using the create-trail command to create a trail
references.quote: By default, the create-trail command creates a trail that logs events only in the AWS Region where the trail was created.
references.supports: Giải thích nguyên nhân: trail tạo bằng CLI mặc định là single-Region; tạo trail mới (C) là thêm một trail riêng.

references.title: AWS CloudTrail pricing
references.quote: You can deliver additional copies of management events, and all other event types including data and network activity events using trails.
references.supports: Hai trail cùng ghi management events tạo bản sao bổ sung thuộc tier trả phí (bất lợi của C nếu giữ trail cũ).

references.title: Amazon S3 Event Notifications
references.quote: You can use the Amazon S3 Event Notifications feature to receive notifications when certain events happen in your S3 bucket.
references.supports: S3 notifications chỉ liên quan sự kiện trong bucket, không thu thập API activity các Region (B).
